original_interpretation: IEEE HIR says 2.1D/2.3D/2.5D labels lack a common basis; proposes '2D enhanced' (2DO organic, 2DS silicon/glass/ceramic interposer or bridge) vs 3D stacked without the package.
evidence_found: "current nomenclature (e.g., 2.1D, 2.3D, 2.5D architectures) does not have a common rational basis"; "...2DO (2D Organic)... if the enhanced architecture uses an inorganic medium (e.g., a silicon/glass/ceramic interposer or bridge)... 2DS"; "A 3D architecture is defined as... stacked and interconnected without the agency of the package." (HIR 2024 ch.22, sections 2-3, pp.2-3)
notes: The 3D definition is 'stacked and interconnected without the agency of the package'; the claim's wording is a fair shortening. This is a roadmap's proposed nomenclature (not a standard).

original_interpretation: IEEE HIR: high-performance flip-chip bump pitch flat at 90 um 2021-2024; 90 um assumed minimum bound for conventional 2D flip chip, so finer pitch needs 2D-enhanced or 3D.
evidence_found: Table 1 'Die-Package Interconnect Pitch Roadmap': "Flip chip – high performance (µm) 110 100 100 90 90 90 90" for 2018-2024; "it is reasonable to assume that 2D flip-chip pitch will stay at a minimum bound of 90µm (this does not cover the fine pitch scaling available in 2D Enhanced and 3D architectures)" (HIR 2024 ch.22, sec. 4, pp.4-5)
notes: Footnote 8 limits the bound to full area-array interconnects. The 'which is why' link is a mild paraphrase of the parenthetical, consistent with the text.

original_interpretation: Hybrid bonding joins Cu pads and dielectric without bumps/underfill/compression (unlike TCB), enabling <10 um pitch; W2W is most mature of W2W/D2W/D2D.
evidence_found: "Hybrid Bonding(HB) has been a key enabling approach to realize fine pitch (<10 um)"; "HB is a method of directly joining two surfaces... typically copper vias and dielectric layers"; "Unlike with thermo-compression bonding (TCB), no bumps, no underfill, or compression is needed"; "3 types of HB... with wafer-to-wafer being the most mature" (ECTC 2025 HB summary, sec. I, p.1)
notes: Claim cites SRC-0553 only. IEEE EPS session summary (tier 2) is reasonable for a technical description.

original_interpretation: CEA-Leti at ECTC 2026: D2W hybrid-bonding test vehicle down to 1 um pitch; expected yields 5-2 um; 1 um yield limited by bonding-tool alignment accuracy.
evidence_found: "demonstrating a functional test vehicle utilizing die-to-wafer (D2W) hybrid bonding with pitches down to 1 μm"; "Electrical characterization of daisy-chain structures confirmed expected performance and yields for pitches ranging from 5 μm down to 2 μm. While the yield at 1 μm is limited by the alignment accuracy of existing bonding tools" (CEA-Leti, 29 May 2026)
notes: Self-reported research result; reported_claim correct.
